changes: Round-2 Deep Audit & Ledger Hardening: Multi-Currency Supplier AP & Statements, Unverified Handover Reversals, Supplier Payment Voids, and 100% Locale Parity

Change Service Contract & Portal Password Fixes (BUG-08, BUG-09): Aligned service_id / new_service_id contract in subscriptions, and added current_password verification and UI in customer portal profile

Multi-Currency Supplier AP & Statement Overhaul (BUG-10, ENH-09): Standardized purchases, purchase returns, and supplier debit notes on base-currency supplier balances, and added dual-currency display (original + base) with clickable linked PO references

FX Rate Override Normalization & Renewal Lock (BUG-11, BUG-12): Migrated foreign exchange overrides across purchases, expenses, returns, and debit notes to ledger.ResolveRateToBase, and added FOR UPDATE stock checks for promotion rewards

Tenant Isolation & Transactional Sequences (BUG-13, BUG-15): Enforced company_id isolation across portal admin bulk actions and customer overwrites, and wrapped sequence counters inside database transactions

Customer Portal Statement & Tickets Polish (BUG-14, BUG-16, BUG-18): Included issued credit notes in statements with per-currency grouping, executed ticket updated_at timestamps, added empty states, error toasts, dynamic status badges, and OTP timer cleanup
SQLC Named Date & 100% Locale Parity (BUG-17, BUG-19): Eliminated the last unnamed ColumnN SQLC parameter and added all missing Arabic and English pluralization and portal keys

Unverified Handover & Supplier Payment Reversals (ENH-06, ENH-07): Added DELETE endpoints and UI actions to reject unverified collector handovers and void supplier payments with full GL reversal and safe balance refunds
Unified pkg/ledger Safe Helpers (ENH-08): Migrated all remaining local safe helpers across expenses, purchases, invoices, and returns to atomic ledger.WithdrawSafe / DepositSafe
